# learn.openapis.org

> The official learning guide for the OpenAPI Specification (OAS), maintained by the [OpenAPI Initiative](https://www.openapis.org) (OAI). It helps API designers and developers learn how to write OpenAPI Descriptions (OADs), machine-readable documents that describe HTTP-based APIs, and answers the "how do I accomplish X?" and "what is the purpose of Y?" questions that are out of scope for the specification itself.

This site is a companion to the [OpenAPI Specification](https://spec.openapis.org/oas/latest). Content is authored in Markdown and built with Jekyll using the Just the Docs theme. Source: https://github.com/OAI/learn.openapis.org
